newsitem.title: USA: Salomon declines comment on BusinessWeek item.
newsitem.headline: Salomon declines comment on BusinessWeek item.

text.p: Salomon Inc declined to comment on a report that it is viewed as a leading potential target in Wall Street's ongoing wave of consolidation, according to a story in BusinessWeek magazine.

The article, which appears in the August 11 edition's "Inside Wall Street" column, quotes unnamed investment bankers and strategists as saying a Swiss bank and a U.S. bank are among those mulling a deal.
Salomon spokesman Robert Baker declined to comment, adding, "It is not our custom to comment on market rumors."
The story suggests Warren Buffett, who controls 18.5 percent of Salomon, might be more inclined to accept a sale than in the past.
Buffett could not be reached for comment.
